note: Unbound from a save (its intro is long): the official UPS patch on FireRed (U) 1.0 and Pokemon Unbound Official.sav next to it – any save that stands where wild Pokémon appear (a cave or tall grass; checked with one in Icy Hole). Continue, read the team (species by the game's own names, held items by its own item names, moves in the app's numbering) and the place sign, walk until a wild Pokémon appears, then run. Complete FireRed Upgrade keeps FireRed's RAM layout (team at 0x02024284, gBattleMons at 0x02023BE4 with FireRed's 0x58-byte battlers) and stores the Pokémon data unencrypted. pos: SaveBlock1 through gSaveBlock1Ptr 0x03005008. probe: gMain.inBattle, gBattleTypeFlags, the party count.

steps.note: walk until a wild Pokémon appears
